summary: Tested STEP 1-3: universal navbar search bar, new /directory Competition Directory page, and cta-explore/cta-guidance-link bug fix (internal /directory navigation instead of external shisfest.com). All primary and secondary test scenarios passed. Frontend-only, no backend testing required.

issues: Substring category matching causes 'Social Science' category events (Talking Titans, Tell A Geo Tale) to also match query 'science', showing 6 results instead of the expected 4 pure-Science-category events. This is a natural consequence of the intentional substring-match-on-category design (as specified: 'filter by event name/category'), not a functional bug, but worth flagging since review expectation stated 'exactly 4'. Recommend no change unless product wants exact category match instead of substring.

action_items: No blocking issues found. Optional: consider whether category substring match for queries like 'science' overlapping with 'Social Science' is desired behavior — currently intentional substring matching, flagged only as an FYI, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.tsx, Directory.tsx, PassCard.tsx, CTASection.tsx, App.tsx all clean, small, well-scoped changes matching the request exactly.

REPORTING_TIME and VENUE correctly hardcoded as module-level constants in Directory.tsx, confirmed identical across all 7 spot-checked events (Slam Poetry, Lingua Quest, Vocal Vibes, Art Attack, Mind Matters, BioFlix, Innovative Idea).
useSearchParams with { replace: true } correctly prevents history flooding on live typing - verified history.length unchanged after typing 5 chars.
Mutual exclusivity of mobile search panel vs hamburger menu correctly implemented and verified.

PassCard.tsx backward-compatible internal/external link switch (href.startsWith('/')) works correctly, verified all Home CTA links still work as intended (internal for directory, external for registration/contact/instagram).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None required - static React SPA using events.ts data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 test scenarios from review_request verified via Playwright: (1) cta-explore and cta-guidance-link now navigate internally to /directory - CONFIRMED FIXED, no external shisfest.com link anymore. (2) Desktop nav search visible on Home/Events/Contact, quiz search -> /directory?q=quiz shows Quizzeria + Complexity and Precision Quiz. (3) Mobile 375px: desktop search hidden, toggle icon shown, expands to full-width autofocused input, submits and closes panel, navigates correctly. (4) No navbar overlap at 320/360/375/390px widths (8px min gap between brand and register button in all cases). (5) Search panel and hamburger menu mutually exclusive - confirmed. (6) /directory loads with correct title, 26/26 count, all rows collapsed by default with icon+name+chevron only. (7) /directory?q=science pre-filters and prefills input, though returns 6 results (includes Social Science category matches) rather than exactly 4 pure Science - this is due to substring matching on category field which is by design per spec, not a bug. (8) Accordion rows expand/collapse independently (verified 2 rows open simultaneously), showing category tag, full description, participants, Venue=TBA, Reporting Time=8:00 a.m. 10th Oct 2026 - all verified identical across 7 different events. (9) Live filtering works without Enter, URL updates via replace (no history growth). (10) Empty state for nonsense search works, shows 'Showing 0 of 26'. (11) Mobile /directory (375px) has no horizontal overflow, accordion fully readable. (12) Events page regression - grid/toggle/modal all still present and functional, no console errors. (13) No console errors on Home, Events, Directory, Contact pages. Everything passed - no retest needed.
